breaking: The box database history is replaced by one file, 001_baseline.sql. A new install applies it. An existing database must first be at the last pre-release file (094_outside_tool_pins.sql), then take the renames listed under "Adopting the migration baseline" in the release notes, then run `pnpm -C services/box migrate --adopt-through 001_baseline.sql` (after a --dry-run). The runner refuses the baseline on an old database that has not adopted it.

The console refuses to start without CONSOLE_SESSION_SECRET_FILE, the path of a file holding the session secret; passing the secret itself as CONSOLE_SESSION_SECRET leaves the console restarting. An installation with its own compose file adds the variable and mounts the file before updating, keeping the secret's value so signed-in owners stay signed in.

The network, company-registry, markets and travel capabilities are removed. A saved agent definition that still holds one shows it as "no longer available in this version", and the next save is refused until the owner removes it.

The built-in company-registry lookup is gone. An installation that wants company data connects an outside tool (MCP server) in the agent's definition; the commercial and sales-outreach skills work without one.

The travel role, its image and the chief of staff's trip reader are removed. The briefs' travel context comes from the calendar alone. A keeper config that still lists travel loads, ignoring those entries with one log line each; the keeper no longer starts, stops or updates a travel agent.

Settings that carried an agent's or organisation's name are renamed: the chief of staff's route password is EVE_ROUTE_PASSWORD_FILE, the per-role model override is AGENT_MODEL, the Strava files are STRAVA_CLIENT_ID_FILE and STRAVA_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE, and Google client pairs are GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID_<ORG>_FILE and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET_<ORG>_FILE. A keeper config that still binds the old route-password name is refused until the binding is renamed.

Brands, the commercial brand list, institutional sender domains and the statutory deadline calendar are no longer in code. Set CRM_BRANDS, COMMERCIAL_BRANDS, INSTITUTIONAL_SENDER_DOMAINS and DEADLINE_CALENDAR_FILE (the last with a read-only mount of the file); a keeper-managed agent can now be given all four. Unset, CRM routing proposes nothing, the who-to-contact tool has no brands, official senders are not recognised by domain, and there is no standing deadline calendar.
